🌺 You're Invited to Celebrate with Us! 🌺
Join us for an evening of Garba • Dandiya • Bollywood Dhamaka as we celebrate NavaShakti Durga Utsav 2026 with our community!
✨ Saturday, October 10, 2026
🕔 5:00 PM onwards
📍 Cole Hall
2950 Washington Blvd., Fremont, CA 94539
🎉 Enjoy:
💃 Energetic Garba & Dandiya🎶 Bollywood music and dancing🍛 Delicious food stalls🛍️ Shopping booths🚗 Free parking🎟️ Free entryThis event is FREE for everyone, and we warmly welcome families, friends, and neighbors to join the celebration.
💛 While admission is free, we kindly request a suggested donation of $5 per person to help cover event expenses and support our community's cultural programs. Every contribution, big or small, is truly appreciated.
📲 Please register using the QR code on the flyer.
Come dressed in your festive attire, bring your dandiya sticks, and let's create a memorable evening filled with music, dance, culture, and joy!
We can't wait to celebrate with you! 🙏✨
